info.name: EMR Appointments API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the EMR appointment module API (/api/v1). Reference: docs/API.md.

1. Set {{baseUrl}} (default http://localhost:5000/api/v1), {{adminEmail}} and {{adminPassword}} (the Super Admin from npm run seed). Keep real credentials in an environment, not in this file.
2. Run Auth > Log in. It stores {{accessToken}}, which every other request sends as a Bearer token (collection auth).
3. Requests store the ids they create ({{departmentId}}, {{doctorId}}, {{patientId}}, {{appointmentId}}, {{secondAppointmentId}}), so the folders run top to bottom.

{{appointmentDate}} is set to the next Monday on first use; the sample doctor works on Mondays.

exec: // Bookings need a future working day: default to the next Monday (local calendar).

request.description: Public. Stores data.accessToken in {{accessToken}}. The refresh token arrives in the emr_refresh cookie (HttpOnly, Secure, path /api/v1/auth), which Postman keeps in its cookie jar.

request.description: Public; needs the emr_refresh cookie from Log in. Rotates the cookie and stores the new access token. The cookie is Secure, so it is only sent over HTTPS or to localhost.

request.description: Public. Revokes the refresh token in the cookie (if any) and clears the cookie. The access token stays valid until it expires.
